text: Operations were successfully completed on the SS Block 112 Well V-5(ST01) to isolate the "R-15" Sand completion existing perforations of 10,728'-10,734' & 10,775'-10,794' MD by setting a TTBP at 10,697' MD and dumping 52' of cement on top of the plug; ETOC at 10,645' MD. The TTBP at 10,697' and cement plug at 10,645' MD were pressure tested to 1000 psi. Subsequent zone change operations were suspended due to tubing x casing communication found and the "R-13" Sand was not perforated for production. Operations began 10/18/2012 and ended 10/22/2012.

text:
Stone performed zone change operations on the PL 23, OCS-G-01238, Well C4ST1BP1 to produce the "CP 28" Sand.  Operations began on August 18, 2008, and were completed on September 30, 2008. The previous producing interval, the "CP 29" Sand was isolated by setting a posi-set plug @ 15310' MD and dumping 25' cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 15285'.  

The "CP 28" Sand was exposed to production by perforating from 15180' - 15192' MD.  The well was turned over to production on October 1, 2008; however, the "CP 28" watered out and did not produce at economic levels.  Test results for October 2, 2008:  38 MCFPD, 0 BCPD, 1600 BWPD.  A Notice of 1st Production is not being filed for the "CP 28" Sand completion interval.  The well is shut-in while waiting for zone change operations to be completed to produce the "CP24" Sand.

Stone performed zone change operations on the PL 23, OCS-G-01238, Well C4ST1BP1 to produce the "CP 28" Sand.  Operations began on August 18, 2008, and were completed on September 30, 2008. The previous producing interval, the "CP 29" Sand was isolated by setting a posi-set plug @ 15310' MD and dumping 25' cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 15285'.  

The "CP 28" Sand was exposed to production by perforating from 15180' - 15192' MD.  The well was turned over to production on October 1, 2008; however, the "CP 28" watered out and did not produce at economic levels.  Test results for October 2, 2008:  38 MCFPD, 0 BCPD, 1600 BWPD.  A Notice of 1st Production is not being filed for the "CP 28" Sand completion interval.  The well is shut-in while waiting for zone change operations to be completed to produce the "CP24" Sand.

evidence.text: BASED ON RESIDUE ON THE TOOLSTRING, IT APPEARS THE RESTRICTION IS A COMBINATION OF ASPHLTENE AND PARAFFIN.

text:
THE SLICKLINE OPERATIONS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS EOR WERE UNSUCCESSFUL DUE TO A RESTRICTION IN THE TUBING. BASED ON RESIDUE ON THE TOOLSTRING, IT APPEARS THE RESTRICTION IS A COMBINATION OF ASPHLTENE AND PARAFFIN. THERREFORE THE APPROVED SLEEVE SHIFT AND DOWNHOLE COMMINGLING COULD NOT BE CONDUCTED.(AS APPROVED 6/25/13.)

THERE WERE NO CHANGES TO THE WELLBORE.
